The City of Greeley has no contests on this ballot. Statewide races, Colorado Supreme Court and Court of Appeals retention, and statewide measures are on the Colorado statewide list. measures.title: City of Greeley Sales and Use Tax Increase for Capital Projects
measures.summary: Raises the City of Greeley sales and use tax rate by 0.6% (excluding the city sales tax on food), estimated at $20 million in 2027, to finance, build, operate and maintain the Downtown Civic Campus project (city hall, plaza, parking garage), the West Greeley Catalyst project (arena, youth ice center, water park, hotel), and recreational, cultural and park facilities. Spending would be subject to review by a citizens committee, and the added tax would end when the Civic Campus and Catalyst project financings are paid off, no later than December 31, 2067.
measures.yesMeans: The city sales and use tax rate rises by 0.6% to fund these capital projects.
measures.noMeans: The city sales and use tax rate stays the same.
